(Japanese: ガラルファイヤー VS ) is the second regular chapter of the manga. It was first published in the January 2024 issue of CoroCoro Comics, released on December 15, 2023. It is based on the episodes Charge! Galar Mine! and Fiery Galarian Moltres. It is 49 pages long, including the color cover.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Liko and Roy are revealed to have joined the Rising Volt Tacklers.
Liko is revealed to have a .
A is revealed to have emerged from Liko's pendant before.
The Rising Volt Tacklers encounter Amethio again.
Liko and Roy encounter Lucius's third Pokémon, a .
Liko is revealed to have taken under her care Lucius's second Pokémon, a .
Roy is revealed to have a .
Lucius's Galarian Moltres goes inside the third Ancient Poké Ball and is taken under Liko's care.
The mysterious Pokémon emerges from Liko's pendant again, but does not change back.
